Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Security Program Management professional with 18+ years of experience leading information security, governance, compliance, risk management, vulnerability management, and cybersecurity transformation initiatives across Banking and Financial Services environments.
Experienced in driving cybersecurity governance, vulnerability remediation coordination, security risk assessments, compliance programs, executive reporting, and stakeholder management across Infrastructure, Cloud, Security Operations, and Compliance teams. Strong exposure to vulnerability management using Qualys, security control assessments, risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and security posture improvement initiatives.
Worked with leading financial institutions including Axis Bank, Citi, American Express, and Deutsche Bank in highly regulated environments. Proven ability to manage complex security programs, governance forums, audit engagements, remediation activities, and cross-functional stakeholder relationships.
Certified CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, PMP, and ISO 27001 Lead Auditor with expertise in cybersecurity governance, risk management, vulnerability management, security compliance, and project delivery.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Manager – Information Security, ISMS & Compliance
LA Tech (Client: Axis Bank)
Jan 2024 – Present
Cybersecurity Governance & Compliance
Lead information security governance and compliance initiatives aligned with ISO 27001:2022, GDPR, NIST 800-53, NESA, and industry security standards.
Conduct information security assessments, IT audits, compliance reviews, and
control effectiveness evaluations.
Perform risk assessments, gap analysis, and security control reviews to identify
and address security weaknesses.
Support development and enhancement of governance frameworks, security
policies, standards, and procedures.
Vulnerability Management & Security Risk Governance
Support enterprise vulnerability management activities through identification,
assessment, prioritization, and remediation coordination.
Conduct vulnerability reviews using Qualys and collaborate with technology
teams to address identified security risks.
Coordinate remediation activities across Infrastructure, Cloud, Security
Operations, and Application teams.
Monitor remediation progress and support timely closure of security findings,
audit observations, and control gaps.
Review vulnerability trends, risk exposure, and business impact to support
remediation prioritization.
Generate management reports covering vulnerability findings, remediation
status, compliance posture, and security risks.
Cloud Security & Access Management
Support security governance across Microsoft Azure environments.
Manage and review security controls related to CASB, Identity & Access
Management, SSO, MFA, and Privileged Access Management.
Monitor privileged account governance and access control effectiveness.
Security Operations & Threat Management
Support DLP, SIEM, EDR, CyberArk, Qualys, and security monitoring initiatives.
Participate in security incident analysis, risk investigations, and security event
reviews.
Conduct vulnerability assessments and remediation validation activities.
Assist in security monitoring, threat detection, and incident reporting processes.
Stakeholder & Governance Management
Collaborate with Infrastructure, Security Operations, Compliance, Risk, Legal,
and Audit teams to improve organizational security posture.
Present security findings, remediation plans, compliance updates, and risk
assessments to management and stakeholders.
Facilitate governance discussions and support internal and external audits.
Coordinate remediation activities for audit observations and regulatory findings.
